summary: End-to-end testing of Plume Suites iteration 3 (11 journal articles in journal_data.py with H2/strong markdown, redesigned SuitesSlider with stats overlay, always-transparent Navbar with scroll-aware color, suite stats sections). 15/15 backend pytest pass, 12/12 frontend flows pass.

issues: No explicit data-testid for stats badges on suite cards (e.g., suite-stats-badge-douceur). The names render but the iteration spec asked for visible stats badges per card. Visual badges may be present but selectors couldn't confirm. Minor — not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='suite-stats-badge-{slug}' on Sejours.jsx cards to make stats badges programmatically detectable.
(Optional, repeat finding) Extract Smoobu and tighten GET /api/contact behind auth before production — exposes contact submissions publicly.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: JOURNAL_ARTICLES extracted to /app/backend/journal_data.py keeps server.py at ~103 lines, well within the 700-line guideline.
Good: Article body renderer correctly parses '## H2', '### H3' and **bold** markdown. Verified 7 H2 + 10 strong on /journal/que-faire-a-dijon-week-end.
Good: Navbar is fully transparent at scroll=0 (rgba(0,0,0,0)) and switches to ink color (rgb(59,49,43)) on scroll — verified via computed style.
Good: Mobile menu opens fully opaque (rgb(59,49,43)) — no transparency leak.
Good: SuiteDetail stats sections render correctly: Douceur=2/4/60m², Envolée=1/2/40m².
Minor: GET /api/contact still unauthenticated — same finding as iteration 1 & 2. Not blocking.
Minor: Stats badges on /sejours card listing have no data-testid, only present at SuiteDetail level.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed contact messages via pytest (2 valid POSTs) and 1 via Playwright contact form. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 15 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covering 11-article journal (cycling first 3, SEO landmarks 4-6), H2 paragraph count assertions, individual fetchability of all 11 slugs, contact CRUD + invalid email 422. Frontend testids: suites-slider, slider-tab-douceur, slider-tab-envolee, slider-next, suite-stats-douceur, suite-stats-envolee, journal-card-{slug} for all 11 slugs (including que-faire-a-dijon-week-end, visiter-beaune-48-heures, climats-bourgogne-unesco), lang-switch-fr/en, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, contact-name/email/subject/message/submit. Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from /app/frontend/.env (it is NOT in shell env by default). Smoobu iframe loads 3 children after ~7s. Navbar bg always transparent rgba(0,0,0,0).
rca of the issue: No issues found in this iteration.
